recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-16312 unless a future work group decision changes the type-slice id convention.
issue_request: FHIR-16312 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core issue from FHIR-I asking to add explicit ElementDefinition.id guidance for type choice slices, using the Patient.deceased[x]:deceasedBoolean example.
initial_application: The request was applied by fc62c9b18bd594a945cf8562b8d2c1ae62ce3184, "GF#16312 - note about elementdefinition.id", matching Jira's svn revision 14314 comment.
additional_context: Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-39180 corrected the example so the path is Patient.deceased[x] and the typed slice element is Patient.deceased[x]:deceasedBoolean. That correction was applied by f554f92b9fc7bca48b797f769a36eb1696dfca0b and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as an active type page and normative artifact, and source/elementdefinition.html currently includes the ElementDefinition.id type choice slice bullet with the corrected example.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the example introduced by FHIR-16312 to avoid treating Patient.deceasedBoolean as an ElementDefinition.path; already audited on the combined branch.
